ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (yellow-white) pixels comprise approximately 70-75% of the visible ventral surface, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixels comprising 25-30% concentrated at borders and linear streaks.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central regions on both lobes; continuous low-intensity perimeter banding along leading and trailing edges; multiple vertical low-intensity linear segments distributed across the medial and lateral zones of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated interior angle of 72 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, with increased peak amplitude (raggedness) visible on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature characterized by a smooth inward sweep from the median notch followed by an outward flare towards the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groupings (barnacle colonies) localized at the extreme distal apex of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Significant detection of at least five near-vertical, low-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks) on the left lobe and three on the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive vertical rake marks across both lobes and focal barnacle clusters at the lobe tips; distinct yellowish pigmentation of the high-intensity regions.
other_distinctive_markers: The yellowish-tan hue of the ventral surface pixels suggests significant diatom film accumulation, deviating from standard white-to-gray pigmentation.
